'''Dawnweave''' is a horse owned by [[Rodel Ituralde]].

==Appearance==
Dawnweave is a white gelding.

==Activities==
Dawnweave was a horse belonging to one of [[Davram Bashere]]'s men. He was given to Ituralde because he is used to [[Trollocs]]. He later dies with a javelin to his neck during the Trolloc assault on [[Maradon]]. As he falls, he breaks Ituralde's leg.{{ref/book|13|21}}
